items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: another intern by the name of Bill Ryan, Joe Ryan was her date and we went over there

ctx.x: Huttage Grove in the second floor and I remember

at the time that Lillian Chris from New Orleans was my wife's best friend. She came up to spend some time with us and another intern by the name of Bill Ryan, Joe Ryan was her date and we went over there and we decided not to dance so the girls wouldn't be exposed to breaks because any of those places anybody could come up to you and ask for part of it. Well, many times these colored boys would even come up to your table even though your wife wasn't dancing and say, could I have part of this? We had instructed…
Oh, that's the way in those days, yeah.
